rationale: Independent QA is reserved after TICKET-PRIORITY-002R3 completed its dispatcher-only remediation. The QA lane must cover the 30 expected contract-failure fixtures and the eleven direct reproductions using an isolated explicit state-location override: dirfd swap, durable outside-worktree derivation, independent receipt, lifecycle successful release, lifecycle failed release, write loop, unsupported platform, non-overlap concurrency, overlap, delete/reacquire, and replay.
